title: CounselPlex: A Stressor-Aware Full-Duplex Counseling Model
abstract: arXiv:2610.32702v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Full-duplex speech models can listen and speak at the same time, enabling natural, low-latency interaction. In counseling, however, these models often focus on the latest utterance and lose track of the seeker's underlying problem. We call this failure Stressor Blindness. We propose CounselPlex, a stressor-aware full-duplex framework that uses two operations. CounselPlex updates a short stressor state during seeker silence and injects this state into  positions while listening. We also introduce RoPE Position Shift Augmentation (RPSA), which broadens positional coverage during training and improves performance at longer turn depths in our evaluation. LLM-judge evaluations show improved counseling quality and stressor grounding over strong baselines.

translated_title: CounselPlex：一种压力源感知的全双工心理咨询模型
translated_abstract: 全双工语音模型可以同时聆听和说话，从而实现自然、低延迟的交互。然而在心理咨询场景中，这类模型往往只关注最近的话语，而丢失了求助者潜在的问题。我们将这种失败称为“压力源盲区”。我们提出了CounselPlex，一个压力源感知的全双工框架，它采用两种操作：CounselPlex在求助者沉默期间更新一个简短的压力源状态，并在聆听过程中将该状态注入到相应位置。我们还引入了RoPE位置偏移增强（RPSA），该方法在训练期间扩展了位置覆盖范围，并在我们的评估中提升了较长对话轮次深度下的性能。基于LLM评判的评估显示，与强基线相比，CounselPlex在心理咨询质量和压力源锚定方面均有提升。
tldr: CounselPlex通过在求助者沉默时更新压力源状态并在聆听时注入该状态，克服了全双工语音模型的“压力源盲区”问题，同时引入RoPE位置偏移增强（RPSA）以提升长对话深度下的性能，从而实现更高质量的心理咨询。
en_tdlr: CounselPlex is a stressor-aware full-duplex counseling model that overcomes Stressor Blindness by updating a short stressor state during seeker silence and injecting it while listening, with RoPE Position Shift Augmentation (RPSA) further improving performance at longer turn depths.
